result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B keeps units in the headers and uses consistent precision, right alignment, and tabular figures in each numeric column. A aligns every figure, including highlighted cells, but repeats a dollar sign in every price cell under a USD header. B’s best-value triangles pull those numbers slightly off the decimal line; both tables still scan cleanly, label one best cell per column, and keep readable numbers on a single line. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A puts units only in the headers and keeps one precision per column, but the best-value triangles sit inline and shift those digits off the shared right edge. Both use a scannable model column, highlight only one best cell per spec with a legend, and keep numbers on a single line at a readable size.
